verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
You are my Light and my Salvation
The stronghold of my life,
The stronghold of my life

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
You are my God and my Defender
You're the stronghold of my life,
The stronghold of my life

verse.name: e1
verse.lines: You are the stronghold of my life

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
You will hide me in Your shelter God
A mighty shield is Your love
From all my foes You deliver me
Now my head is lifted up

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
I will not fear (in the day of battle)
I will not fear (with a shout of joy I sing)

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
I will not fear
For the great I Am is here
For the great I Am is here

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
So I seek Your Face,
I long to know Your ways
I will trust and wait,
Upon Your goodness Lord
